The club

About the Roar

Roxbury Roar were one of four charter clubs when the Hudson Valley Hockey Conference dropped its first puck in October 1998, and the franchise has not missed a single Lewis Cup playoff since the 2007-08 season — a 19-year run that's the longest active streak in the league. The Roar hoisted their first Cup in 2017 behind goaltender Sam Boyer (now an assistant coach), added a second in 2024 on a Game 7 overtime winner from then-16-year-old Mateusz Kowalczyk, and made it three in March 2026 with a 4-2 series victory over Beacon. Three championships in eleven seasons puts the club in a tie with Beacon and Kingston for the most titles in HVHC history.

Home games are played at Roxbury Memorial Arena, the league's oldest active barn. The 1,840-seat rink opened on Hemlock Street in 1972 as a single-pad facility, added a second sheet in 1998 to coincide with the Roar's founding, and underwent a $4.2M refresh in 2021 that upgraded the boards, glass, scoreboard, and the famous low-ceiling press box. The Cup banner from 2026 will be raised before the team's home opener against Catskill on October 11, joining the 2017 and 2024 flags above the south goal.

The bench

Coaching Staff & Front Office

Greg Sokolowski

Head Coach
6th season · 2025-26 Coach of the Year

A Margaretville native and former HVHC defenseman with the 2003-04 Cup-winning Hudson Hawks. Sokolowski took the Roxbury bench in 2020 after eight years coaching prep hockey at Storm King; he owns a 142-71-19 regular-season record and two Cup banners with the Roar.

Sam Boyer

Associate Coach
3rd season · Goaltending focus

Backstopped Roxbury to the 2017 Cup as a 17-year-old netminder, then played four years at Hamilton College. Boyer rejoined the staff in 2023 and is widely credited with developing McKenna into a league-best save percentage goaltender.

Maria Castellanos

Assistant Coach
2nd season · Forwards & PP

Former Quinnipiac and NWHL forward who runs the Roar's power play (a league-leading 26.4% in 2025-26). Joined the staff after coaching the Hudson Valley Premier U16 girls team to a state title in 2024.

Steve "Jano" Janowski

Goaltending Coach
11th season · Longest-tenured staffer

A fixture at Roxbury Memorial since the 2015-16 season. Jano runs the famed 6am Tuesday "blue paint" sessions and has mentored four Roar goaltenders who went on to NCAA Division I commits.

Dana Whittaker, MAT, ATC

Head Athletic Trainer
4th season

Lead athletic trainer and concussion specialist, based out of Riverbend Physical Therapy in Margaretville. Whittaker oversees the Roar's return-to-play protocol and travels with the club to all road games.

Frank Eldridge

General Manager
9th season

A Roxbury Memorial fixture since the late nineties when he coached youth ball, Eldridge took the GM job in 2017 and has presided over all three of the Roar's Cup victories. Drafted Kowalczyk out of Beacon's youth program in 2022.
